ar: صَفِّ الْبَقَآءَ بِهِ لِى فِيكَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: bismil ilaahi ikfinil akdaara yal laahu
saffil baqaa-a bihi lii fiika yal laahu
bayts.fr: Au Nom de Dieu : préserve-moi des troubles, ô Allah ; par lui rends pure pour moi la permanence en Toi, ô Allah.
bayts.en: In the Name of God: spare me all turbidity, O Allah; through it make pure for me abiding in You, O Allah.
bayts.it: Nel Nome di Dio: preservami dai torbidi, o Allah; per mezzo di esso rendi pura per me la permanenza in Te, o Allah.

ar: يَامَنْ لَّهُ الْأَمْرُ يَامَنْ لَّاشَرِيكَ لَهُ
tr: yaa man lahul amru yaa man laashariika lahu
wassih wa mallik wa atliq fiika yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Celui à qui appartient le Commandement, ô Celui qui n'a point d'associé : élargis, rends maître et libère(-moi) en Toi, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O He to Whom the Command belongs, O He Who has no partner: expand, make master and set (me) free in You, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Colui al quale appartiene il Comando, o Colui che non ha associato: allarga, rendi padrone e libera (me) in Te, o Allah.

ar: فَوْزِى بِمَا ثِئْتُ فِى دُنْيَاكَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: waajahtukal yawma yaa rahmaanu murtajiyan
fawzii bimaa si-tu fii dunyaaka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Je me suis tourné vers Toi aujourd'hui, ô Tout-Miséricordieux (Ar-Raḥmān), espérant mon succès en ce que j'ai voulu dans Ton monde, ô Allah.
bayts.en: I have turned to You today, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), hoping for my success in what I have willed in Your world, O Allah.
bayts.it: Mi sono rivolto a Te oggi, o Compassionevole (Ar-Raḥmān), sperando il mio successo in ciò che ho voluto nel Tuo mondo, o Allah.

ar: أَنْ لَّآ أُلَاقِىَ ضُرًّا مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: antar rahiimul lazii arjuu birahmatihi
an laa ulaaqiya durran minka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Très-Miséricordieux (Ar-Raḥīm), par la miséricorde duquel j'espère ne rencontrer aucun mal de Ta part, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), by Whose mercy I hope to meet no harm from You, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Misericordioso (Ar-Raḥīm), per la cui misericordia spero di non incontrare danno da Te, o Allah.

tr: mallik yamiinii wa qalbis su-la yaa malikii
bilaa hisaabin bijuudin minka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Rends maîtres ma droite et mon cœur de ce que je demande, ô mon Roi (Al-Malik), sans compter, par générosité de Ta part, ô Allah.
bayts.en: Make my right hand and my heart masters of what I ask, O my King (Al-Malik), without reckoning, by generosity from You, O Allah.
bayts.it: Rendi padroni la mia destra e il mio cuore di ciò che chiedo, o mio Re (Al-Malik), senza conto, per generosità da parte Tua, o Allah.

tr: qaddasta sirriya yaa qudduusu murtadiyan
hannii wa hanka radiitud dahra yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu as sanctifié mon secret, ô Très-Saint (Al-Quddūs), satisfait de moi ; et de Toi je me suis satisfait pour toujours, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have sanctified my secret, O Most Holy (Al-Quddūs), well pleased with me; and with You I am well pleased forever, O Allah.
bayts.it: Hai santificato il mio segreto, o Santissimo (Al-Quddūs), compiaciuto di me; e di Te mi sono compiaciuto per sempre, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ الَّذِى سَلَّمْتَ كُلِّىَ مِنْ
tr: antas salaamul lazii sallamta kulliya min
huyuubi nafsii bitayyin minka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es la Paix (As-Salām), qui as préservé tout mon être des défauts de mon âme, en les repliant (au loin) de Ta part, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Peace (As-Salām), Who have kept my whole being safe from the faults of my soul, folding them (away) from You, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei la Pace (As-Salām), che hai preservato tutto il mio essere dai difetti della mia anima, ripiegandoli (via) da parte Tua, o Allah.

ar: يَامُومِنُ اكْفِ جَنَابِى الضُّرَّ مَعْ كَدَرٍ
وَهَبْ لِىَ الْأَمْنَ فِى الدَّارَيْنِ يَاللَّهُ
tr: yaa muuminu ikfi janaabid durra mah kadarin
wa hab liyal amna fid daarayni yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Garant de la foi (Al-Muʾmin), préserve ma personne du mal et du trouble, et donne-moi la sécurité dans les deux Demeures, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Giver of faith (Al-Muʾmin), spare my person harm and turbidity, and grant me safety in the two Abodes, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Garante della fede (Al-Muʾmin), preserva la mia persona dal danno e dal torbido, e donami la sicurezza nelle due Dimore, o Allah.

ar: قَدْ بِعْتُ سِرًّا إِلَى الْجَنَّاتِ يَاللَّهُ
tr: wa bil muhaymini lish had bishtiraa-ika maa
qad bihtu sirran ilal jannati yal laahu
bayts.fr: Et en tant que Vigilant (Al-Muhaymin) témoigne pour moi de Ton achat de ce que j'ai vendu en secret, (en échange) des Jardins (Coran 9:111), ô Allah.
bayts.en: And as Guardian (Al-Muhaymin) bear witness for me to Your purchase of what I sold in secret, (in exchange) for the Gardens (Qurʾān 9:111), O Allah.
bayts.it: E come Vigilante (Al-Muhaymin) testimonia per me il Tuo aver acquistato ciò che ho venduto in segreto, (in cambio) dei Giardini (Corano 9:111), o Allah.

tr: antal haziizul lazii abghii bihizzatihi
hizzan yukhalidu lit takriima yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Puissant (Al-ʿAzīz), par la puissance duquel je désire une puissance qui rende éternel pour moi l'honneur : Allah !
bayts.en: You are the Mighty (Al-ʿAzīz), by Whose might I seek a might that makes honour everlasting for me: Allah!
bayts.it: Tu sei il Potente (Al-ʿAzīz), per la cui potenza desidero una potenza che renda eterno per me l'onore: Allah!

ar: أَجْبَرْتَ لِى إِنَّكَ الْجَبَّارُ دُونَ لِقَآ
كُلَّ الْعِدَى بِالَّذِى لِى اخْتَرْتَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: ajbarta lii innakal jabbaaru duuna liqaa
kullal hidaa bil lazii likh tarta yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu as contraint pour moi — Tu es le Contraignant (Al-Jabbār) — sans affrontement, tous les ennemis, par ce que Tu as choisi pour moi, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have compelled for me — You are the Compeller (Al-Jabbār) — without encounter, all the enemies, by what You chose for me, O Allah.
bayts.it: Hai costretto per me — Tu sei l'Irresistibile (Al-Jabbār) — senza scontro, tutti i nemici, con ciò che per me hai scelto, o Allah.

ar: كَفَيْتَنِى كُلَّ ذِى كِبْرِ بِلَا كُلَفٍ
tr: kafaytanii kulla zii kibri bilaa kulafin
yaa mutakabbiru rudtal kulla yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu m'as préservé de tout orgueilleux, sans peine ; ô Superbe (Al-Mutakabbir), Tu as dompté tous, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have spared me every proud one, without toil; O Supreme in Greatness (Al-Mutakabbir), You have tamed them all, O Allah.
bayts.it: Mi hai preservato da ogni superbo, senza fatica; o Superbo (Al-Mutakabbir), hai domato tutti, o Allah.

ar: يَاخَالِقَ الْخَلْقِ لِى اخْلُقْ مَآ أَشَآ أَبَدًا
tr: yaa khaaliqal khalqi likh luq maa ashaa abadan
bil bishri was safwi war ridwaani yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Créateur (Al-Khāliq) de la création, crée pour moi ce que je désire, pour toujours, avec allégresse, pureté et agrément, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Creator (Al-Khāliq) of creation, create for me what I wish, forever, with gladness, purity and good pleasure, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Creatore (Al-Khāliq) della creazione, crea per me ciò che desidero, per sempre, con letizia, purezza e compiacimento, o Allah.

ar: يَابَارِىءَ الْخَلْقِ قُدْ لِى النَّفْعَ دُونَ أَذًى
tr: yaa baarii-al khalqi qud lin nafha duuuna azan
wa qud liyal ajra lil jannaati yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Producteur (Al-Bāriʾ) de la création, conduis-moi le bienfait sans mal, et conduis-moi la récompense pour les Jardins, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Maker (Al-Bāriʾ) of creation, lead benefit to me without harm, and lead to me the reward for the Gardens, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Produttore (Al-Bāriʾ) della creazione, conducimi il beneficio senza danno, e conducimi la ricompensa per i Giardini, o Allah.

tr: antal musawwiru khallid lin nabii bushran
wa sawwiran liya duunal makri yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Façonneur (Al-Muṣawwir) : rends éternelles pour le Prophète des bonnes nouvelles, et façonne pour moi (le bien) sans ruse, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Fashioner (Al-Muṣawwir): make glad tidings everlasting for the Prophet, and fashion (good) for me without guile, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Plasmatore (Al-Muṣawwir): rendi eterne per il Profeta buone novelle, e plasma per me (il bene) senza inganno, o Allah.

ar: غَفَرْتَ لِى كُلَّ ذَنْبٍ قَدْ أَتَيْتُ بِهِ
tr: ghafarta lii kulla zanbin qad ataytu bihi
lish had bishukriya yaa ghaffaaru yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu m'as pardonné tout péché que j'ai commis : témoigne pour moi de ma gratitude, ô Pardonneur (Al-Ghaffār), ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have forgiven me every sin I committed: bear witness for me to my gratitude, O Forgiver (Al-Ghaffār), O Allah.
bayts.it: Mi hai perdonato ogni peccato che ho commesso: testimonia per me la mia gratitudine, o Perdonatore (Al-Ghaffār), o Allah.

ar: قَهَرْتَ لِى رَبِّ أَعْدَآءِى بِلَا سَبَبٍ
tr: qaharta lii rabbi ahdaa-ii bilaa sababin
minnii hamidttuka yaa qahhaaru yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu as dompté pour moi, Seigneur, mes ennemis, sans cause de ma part : je T'ai loué, ô Dominateur (Al-Qahhār), ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have subdued my enemies for me, Lord, without cause on my part: I have praised You, O Subduer (Al-Qahhār), O Allah.
bayts.it: Hai domato per me, Signore, i miei nemici, senza causa da parte mia: Ti ho lodato, o Dominatore (Al-Qahhār), o Allah.

ar: وَهَبْتَ لِى مِنْكَ سُؤْلًا فَاقَ مَسْئَلَتِى
tr: wa habta lii minka su-lan faaqa mas-alatii
falaka shukriya yaa wahhaabu yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu m'as donné de Ta part une requête (exaucée) qui a dépassé ma demande : à Toi donc ma gratitude, ô Donateur (Al-Wahhāb), ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have given me from Yourself a request (granted) that surpassed my asking: so to You is my gratitude, O Bestower (Al-Wahhāb), O Allah.
bayts.it: Mi hai donato da parte Tua una richiesta (esaudita) che ha superato la mia domanda: a Te dunque la mia gratitudine, o Donatore (Al-Wahhāb), o Allah.

ar: لِى قُدْتَّ أَثْمَانَ لَجْ يَامَنْ لَّهُ عُمُرِى
tr: lii qudtta asmaana laj yaa man lahu humurii
wa qudtta lir rizqa yaa razzaaqu yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu m'as conduit les prix (les récompenses) de l'abîme marin, ô Celui à qui (appartient) ma vie, et Tu m'as conduit la subsistance, ô Pourvoyeur (Ar-Razzāq), ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have led to me the prices (the rewards) of the deep sea, O He to Whom my life (belongs), and You have led sustenance to me, O Provider (Ar-Razzāq), O Allah.
bayts.it: Mi hai condotto i prezzi (le ricompense) dell'abisso marino, o Colui al quale (appartiene) la mia vita, e mi hai condotto il sostentamento, o Provveditore (Ar-Razzāq), o Allah.

ar: فَتَحْتَ لِى كُلَّ بَابٍ كُنْتَ فَاتِحَهُ
tr: fatahta lii kulla baabin kunta faatihahu
li-awliyaa-ika yaa fattaahu yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu m'as ouvert toute porte que Tu avais ouverte à Tes saints, ô Celui qui ouvre (Al-Fattāḥ), ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have opened for me every door You had opened for Your saints, O Opener (Al-Fattāḥ), O Allah.
bayts.it: Mi hai aperto ogni porta che avevi aperto ai Tuoi santi, o Apritore (Al-Fattāḥ), o Allah.

tr: hallamtanil ghayba hattaa sirtu muntabihan
antal haliimul lazii hallamta yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu m'as enseigné l'invisible jusqu'à ce que je devienne éveillé : Tu es l'Omniscient (Al-ʿAlīm) qui as enseigné, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have taught me the unseen until I became awakened: You are the All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm) Who have taught, O Allah.
bayts.it: Mi hai insegnato l'invisibile finché sono divenuto desto: Tu sei l'Onnisciente (Al-ʿAlīm) che hai insegnato, o Allah.

tr: qabadta yaa qaabidul aswaa-a wan sarafat
lighayri nahwiya kal akdaari yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu as resserré, ô Celui qui resserre (Al-Qābiḍ), les maux, et ils se sont tournés vers une autre direction que la mienne, comme les troubles, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have withheld, O Withholder (Al-Qābiḍ), the evils, and they turned toward another direction than mine, like the turbid things, O Allah.
bayts.it: Hai stretto, o Colui che restringe (Al-Qābiḍ), i mali, ed essi si sono volti verso altra direzione che la mia, come i torbidi, o Allah.

tr: basatta yaa baasitul aamaala lii biridan
fashkur mubaasatatid daarayni yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu as étendu, ô Celui qui étend (Al-Bāsiṭ), les espoirs pour moi avec agrément : agrée donc mon intimité dans les deux Demeures, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have expanded, O Expander (Al-Bāsiṭ), hopes for me with good pleasure: so accept my intimacy in the two Abodes, O Allah.
bayts.it: Hai esteso, o Colui che estende (Al-Bāsiṭ), le speranze per me con compiacimento: gradisci dunque la mia confidenza nelle due Dimore, o Allah.

tr: khafadta yaa khaafidul ahdaa-a lii wa madaw
lighayri nahwii bikhafdin minka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu as abaissé, ô Celui qui abaisse (Al-Khāfiḍ), les ennemis pour moi, et ils sont partis vers une autre direction que la mienne, par un abaissement de Ta part, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have abased, O Abaser (Al-Khāfiḍ), the enemies for me, and they went off toward another direction than mine, by an abasing from You, O Allah.
bayts.it: Hai abbassato, o Colui che abbassa (Al-Khāfiḍ), i nemici per me, ed essi sono andati verso altra direzione che la mia, con un abbassamento da parte Tua, o Allah.

tr: rafahta yaa raafihud daarayni martabatii
bilan khifaadi bifadlin minka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu as élevé, ô Celui qui élève (Ar-Rāfiʿ), dans les deux Demeures mon rang, sans abaissement, par grâce de Ta part, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have raised, O Exalter (Ar-Rāfiʿ), my rank in the two Abodes, without abasement, by grace from You, O Allah.
bayts.it: Hai innalzato, o Colui che innalza (Ar-Rāfiʿ), nelle due Dimore il mio rango, senza abbassamento, per grazia da parte Tua, o Allah.

tr: antal muhizzul lazii laa zamtu hizzatahu
khillan muhazzan wa hibban fiika yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es Celui qui honore (Al-Muʿizz), à la puissance duquel je me suis attaché, (moi) ami honoré et aimé en Toi, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Bestower of honour (Al-Muʿizz), to Whose might I have clung, (I) an honoured friend and beloved in You, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei Colui che dà onore (Al-Muʿizz), alla cui potenza mi sono stretto, (io) amico onorato e amato in Te, o Allah.

tr: antal muzillul lazii zallat lihizzatihi
al insu wal jinnu wash shaytaanu yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es Celui qui humilie (Al-Mudhill), devant la puissance duquel se sont humiliés les hommes, les djinns et Satan, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Humiliator (Al-Mudhill), before Whose might mankind, the jinn and Satan have been humbled, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei Colui che umilia (Al-Mudhill), alla cui potenza si sono umiliati gli uomini, i jinn e Satana, o Allah.

tr: antas samiihul lazii naajaytuhu zamanan
wa bil masaraati lii qad judtta yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es l'Audient (As-Samīʿ), avec qui j'ai conversé intimement longtemps, et de joies Tu m'as été prodigue, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the All-Hearing (As-Samīʿ), with Whom I have conversed intimately for a long time, and with joys You have been lavish to me, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei l'Audiente (As-Samīʿ), con cui ho conversato intimamente a lungo, e di gioie mi sei stato prodigo, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الْبَصِيرُ الَّذِى لِى قَادَ جُمْلَةَ مَا
لِى اخْتَرْتَ دُنْيَا وَأُخْرَى مِنْكَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: antal basiirul lazii lii qaada jumlata maa
likh tarta dunyaa wa ukhraa minka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Clairvoyant (Al-Baṣīr), qui m'a conduit l'ensemble de ce que Tu as choisi pour moi, en ce monde et dans l'autre, de Ta part, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the All-Seeing (Al-Baṣīr), Who has led to me all that You chose for me, in this world and the next, from You, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Veggente (Al-Baṣīr), che mi ha condotto l'insieme di ciò che hai scelto per me, in questo mondo e nell'altro, da parte Tua, o Allah.

ar: فَوْزٍ بَمَا غَابِ مِنْ بُشْرَاكَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: hakamta yaa hakamul baaqii bikawniya zaa
fawzin bimaa ghaabi min bushraaka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu as décrété, ô Juge (Al-Ḥakam) Éternel, que je sois détenteur du succès, par ce qui est caché de Tes bonnes nouvelles, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have decreed, O Everlasting Judge (Al-Ḥakam), that I be a possessor of success, through what is hidden of Your glad tidings, O Allah.
bayts.it: Hai decretato, o Giudice (Al-Ḥakam) Eterno, che io sia possessore di successo, per ciò che è nascosto delle Tue buone novelle, o Allah.

ar: وَلَا ضِرَارٍ وَلِى قَدْ كُنْتَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: hatalta yaa hadlu ahdaa-ii bighayri liqaa
walaa diraarin wa lii qad kunta yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu as traîné au loin, ô Juste (Al-ʿAdl), mes ennemis, sans affrontement ni dommage, et pour moi Tu as été, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You have dragged away, O Just (Al-ʿAdl), my enemies, without encounter or harm, and You have been for me, O Allah.
bayts.it: Hai trascinato via, o Giusto (Al-ʿAdl), i miei nemici, senza scontro né danno, e per me sei stato, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ اللَّطِيفُ الَّذِى قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى أَبَدًا
tr: antal latiiful lazii qad qudtta lii abadan
lutfan hajiiban yaziidul fikra yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Subtil (Al-Laṭīf), qui m'as conduit pour toujours une subtile bienveillance merveilleuse qui accroît la réflexion, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Subtle (Al-Laṭīf), Who have led to me forever a wondrous subtle kindness that increases reflection, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Sottile (Al-Laṭīf), che mi hai condotto per sempre una sottile benevolenza mirabile che accresce la riflessione, o Allah.

ar: وَقُدْتَّ لِى مِنْكَ عِلْمَ الْغَيْبِ يَاللَّهُ
tr: antal khabiirul lazii haayantu khubratahu
wa qudtta lii minka hilmal ghaybi yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Parfaitement Informé (Al-Khabīr), dont j'ai vu de mes yeux la connaissance, et Tu m'as conduit de Ta part la science de l'invisible, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the All-Aware (Al-Khabīr), Whose knowledge I have seen with my eyes, and You have led to me from You the knowledge of the unseen, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Ben Informato (Al-Khabīr), la cui conoscenza ho visto con i miei occhi, e mi hai condotto da Te la scienza dell'invisibile, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الْحَلِيمُ الَّذِى زَحْزَحْتَ جُمْلَتَ مَنْ
لَّمْ تَرْضَهُمْ لِى لِغَيْرِى الدَّهْرَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: antal haliimul lazii zahzahta jumlata man
lam tardahum lii lighayrid dahra yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Longanime (Al-Ḥalīm), qui as écarté tous ceux que Tu n'as pas agréés pour moi, vers d'autres, pour toujours, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Forbearing (Al-Ḥalīm), Who have removed all those You did not approve for me, toward others, forever, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Clemente (Al-Ḥalīm), che hai allontanato tutti coloro che non hai gradito per me, verso altri, per sempre, o Allah.

ar: لِى قُدْتَّ فَضْلًا عَظِيمًا مِّنْكَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: antal haziimul lazii baanat hazaamatuhu
lii qudtta fadlan haziiman minka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es l'Immense (Al-ʿAẓīm), dont la grandeur est apparue ; Tu m'as conduit une faveur immense de Ta part, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Magnificent (Al-ʿAẓīm), Whose greatness has appeared; You have led to me an immense favour from You, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei l'Immenso (Al-ʿAẓīm), la cui grandezza è apparsa; mi hai condotto un favore immenso da parte Tua, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الَّذِى لِى قُدْتَّ مَغْفِرَةً
tr: antal ghafuurul lazii lii qudta maghfiratan
mahat huyuubii radiitu hanka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Très-Pardonnant (Al-Ghafūr), qui m'as conduit un pardon qui a effacé mes défauts : je me suis satisfait de Toi, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the All-Forgiving (Al-Ghafūr), Who have led to me a forgiveness that effaced my faults: I am well pleased with You, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Perdonatore (Al-Ghafūr), che mi hai condotto un perdono che ha cancellato i miei difetti: mi sono compiaciuto di Te, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الشَّكُورُ الَّذِى كُلِّى لَدَيْكَ رِضًى
tr: antash shakuurul lazii kullii ladayka ridan
wa lii shakarta jamiihis sahyi yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Reconnaissant (Ash-Shakūr), auprès de qui tout mon être est agrément, et pour moi Tu as agréé tout l'effort, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr), with Whom my whole being is good pleasure, and for me You have appreciated all the striving, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Riconoscente (Ash-Shakūr), presso cui tutto il mio essere è compiacimento, e per me hai gradito tutto lo sforzo, o Allah.

tr: antal haliyyul lazii ahlaytanii abadan
bighayri makrin wa lii hallalta yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Très-Haut (Al-ʿAlī), qui m'as élevé pour toujours sans ruse, et pour moi Tu as rendu licite (le bien), ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Most High (Al-ʿAlī), Who have raised me forever without guile, and for me You have made (good) lawful, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei l'Altissimo (Al-ʿAlī), che mi hai innalzato per sempre senza inganno, e per me hai reso lecito (il bene), o Allah.

ar: لِى قُدْتَّ مِنْكَ كَبِيرَ الْأَجْرِ يَاللَّهُ
tr: antal kabiirul lazii baanat kabaaratuhu
lii qudtta minka kabiiral ajri yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Grand (Al-Kabīr), dont la grandeur est apparue ; Tu m'as conduit de Ta part une grande récompense, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Great (Al-Kabīr), Whose greatness has appeared; You have led to me from You a great reward, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Grande (Al-Kabīr), la cui grandezza è apparsa; mi hai condotto da Te una grande ricompensa, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الْحَفِيظُ الَّذِى وَجَّهْتَ فِى أَبَدٍ
tr: antal hafiizul lazii wajjahta fii abadin
ilaa siwaayal hidaa wa durra yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Gardien (Al-Ḥafīẓ), qui as tourné pour toujours vers d'autres que moi les ennemis et le mal, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ), Who have turned forever toward others than me the enemies and harm, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Custode (Al-Ḥafīẓ), che hai rivolto per sempre verso altri che me i nemici e il danno, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الْمُقِيتُ الَّذِى خَلَّدْتَّ لِى رَغَدًا
tr: antal muqiitul lazii khalladta lii raghadan
bilaa hisaabin ilal jannaati yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Nourricier (Al-Muqīt), qui as rendu perpétuelle pour moi l'aisance, sans compter, jusqu'aux Jardins, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Sustainer (Al-Muqīt), Who have made ease everlasting for me, without reckoning, until the Gardens, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Nutritore (Al-Muqīt), che hai reso perenne per me l'agiatezza, senza conto, fino ai Giardini, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الْحَسِيبُ الَّذِى قَدِ اكْتَفَيْتُ بِهِ
tr: antal hasiibul lazii qadik tafaytu bihi
hanil hidaa wal azaa wal kaddi yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es Celui qui suffit (Al-Ḥasīb), dont je me suis contenté, (à l'abri) des ennemis, du mal et de la peine, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Sufficient Reckoner (Al-Ḥasīb), with Whom I have been content, (sheltered) from enemies, harm and toil, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei Colui che basta (Al-Ḥasīb), del quale mi sono accontentato, (al riparo) dai nemici, dal danno e dalla fatica, o Allah.

tr: antal jaliilul lazii saaqat jalaalatuhu
ilaa siwaanal hidad daarayni yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Majestueux (Al-Jalīl), dont la majesté a poussé vers d'autres que nous les ennemis, dans les deux Demeures, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Majestic (Al-Jalīl), Whose majesty has driven the enemies toward others than us, in the two Abodes, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Maestoso (Al-Jalīl), la cui maestà ha sospinto verso altri che noi i nemici, nelle due Dimore, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الْكَرِيمُ الَّذِى قَدْ قُدْتَّ لِى كَرَمًا
tr: antal kariimul lazii qad qudtta lii karaman
dunyaa wa ukhraa mahat tabshiiri yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Généreux (Al-Karīm), qui m'as conduit la générosité en ce monde et dans l'autre, avec la bonne nouvelle, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Generous (Al-Karīm), Who have led generosity to me in this world and the next, with glad tidings, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Generoso (Al-Karīm), che mi hai condotto generosità in questo mondo e nell'altro, con la buona novella, o Allah.

tr: antar raqiibul lazii baanat siyaanatuhu
kulliyyatii han siwar ridwaani yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es l'Observateur (Ar-Raqīb), dont la garde de tout mon être, contre ce qui n'est pas agrément, est apparue, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Watchful (Ar-Raqīb), Whose guarding of my whole being, from all that is not good pleasure, has appeared, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei l'Osservatore (Ar-Raqīb), la cui custodia di tutto il mio essere, da ciò che non è compiacimento, è apparsa, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الْمُجِيبُ الَّذِى انْقَادَتْ بِغَيْرِ عَنَآ
إِجَابَةٌ مِنْكَ لِى لِى اخْتَرْتَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: antal mujiibul lazin qaadat bighayri hanaa
ijaabatun minka lii likhtarta yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es Celui qui exauce (Al-Mujīb), par qui sans peine s'est soumise (à moi) une réponse de Ta part, pour moi, en ce que Tu as choisi pour moi, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Responsive (Al-Mujīb), through Whom without toil an answer from You has yielded (to me), for me, in what You chose for me, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei Colui che esaudisce (Al-Mujīb), da cui senza fatica si è sottomessa (a me) una risposta da parte Tua, per me, in ciò che per me hai scelto, o Allah.

tr: wa innakal waasihul baaqii wa lii abadan
wassahta tawsihatan bil hitqi yal laahu
bayts.fr: Et en vérité Tu es le Vaste (Al-Wāsiʿ), l'Éternel, et pour moi, pour toujours, Tu as élargi une ampleur par l'affranchissement (du Feu), ô Allah.
bayts.en: And truly You are the All-Embracing (Al-Wāsiʿ), the Everlasting, and for me, forever, You have widened a breadth with emancipation (from the Fire), O Allah.
bayts.it: E in verità Tu sei il Vasto (Al-Wāsiʿ), l'Eterno, e per me, per sempre, hai allargato un'ampiezza con l'affrancamento (dal Fuoco), o Allah.

tr: antal hakiimul lazii alaqtanii lisiwaa
maasaa-anii wa mawtas suu-a yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Sage (Al-Ḥakīm), qui m'as rendu apte à autre chose que ce qui m'affligeait, et Tu as effacé le mal, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Wise (Al-Ḥakīm), Who have made me fit for other than what grieved me, and You have effaced the evil, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Saggio (Al-Ḥakīm), che mi hai reso adatto ad altro che ciò che mi affliggeva, e hai cancellato il male, o Allah.

tr: antal waduudul lazin qaadat mawaddatuhu
lii sarmadan bir ridaa wal qurbi yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Très-Aimant (Al-Wadūd), dont l'amour s'est donné à moi éternellement avec l'agrément et la proximité, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Loving (Al-Wadūd), Whose love has yielded to me forever with good pleasure and nearness, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei l'Amorevole (Al-Wadūd), il cui amore si è dato a me in eterno con il compiacimento e la vicinanza, o Allah.

ar: وَقُدْتَّ لِى مِنْكَ مَجْدًا فَاقَ يَاللَّهُ
tr: antal majiidul lazii baanat majaadatuhu
wa qudtta lii minka majdan faaqa yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Glorieux (Al-Majīd), dont la gloire est apparue, et Tu m'as conduit de Ta part une gloire qui (tout) surpasse, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Glorious (Al-Majīd), Whose glory has appeared, and You have led to me from You a glory that surpasses (all), O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Glorioso (Al-Majīd), la cui gloria è apparsa, e mi hai condotto da Te una gloria che (tutto) supera, o Allah.

tr: wa innakal baahisul mubqii bilaa dararin
kafaytanii jumlatal akdaari yal laahu
bayts.fr: Et en vérité Tu es Celui qui ressuscite (Al-Bāʿith), qui fait durer sans dommage : Tu m'as préservé de tous les troubles, ô Allah.
bayts.en: And truly You are the Resurrector (Al-Bāʿith), Who makes endure without harm: You have spared me all turbidity, O Allah.
bayts.it: E in verità Tu sei Colui che risuscita (Al-Bāʿith), che fa perdurare senza danno: mi hai preservato da tutti i torbidi, o Allah.

tr: antash shahiidul lazin qaadat shahaadatuhu
lii bishtiraa-ika minnii zaaka yal laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Témoin (Ash-Shahīd), dont le témoignage m'est acquis de Ton achat de moi de cela (que j'ai vendu), ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Witness (Ash-Shahīd), Whose testimony has yielded to me of Your purchase from me of that (which I sold), O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Testimone (Ash-Shahīd), la cui testimonianza si è data a me del Tuo acquisto da me di quello (che ho venduto), o Allah.

ar: يَاحَقُّ لِى اشْهَدْ بِحَقٍ وَامْحُ جُمْلَةَ مَا
لَمْ تَرْضَ لِى مُطْلَقًا بِالْفَضْلِ يَاللَّهُ
tr: yaa haqqu lish had bihaqqin wamhu jumlata maa
lam tarda lii mutlaqan bil fadli yal laahu
bayts.fr: Ô Vérité (Al-Ḥaqq), témoigne pour moi avec vérité, et efface tout ce que Tu n'as pas agréé pour moi, absolument, par grâce, ô Allah.
bayts.en: O Truth (Al-Ḥaqq), bear witness for me with truth, and efface all that You have not approved for me, absolutely, by grace, O Allah.
bayts.it: O Verità (Al-Ḥaqq), testimonia per me con verità, e cancella tutto ciò che non hai gradito per me, in assoluto, per grazia, o Allah.

ar: أَنْتَ الْوَكِيلُ الَّذِى قَدِ اكْتَفَيْتُ بِهِ
فِى الدَّفْعِ وَالْجَلْبِ يَاذَا الْخَلْقِ يَاللَّهُ
tr: antal wakiilul lazii qadik tafaytu bihi
fid dafhi wal jalbi yaa zal khalqi yaa laahu
bayts.fr: Tu es le Garant (Al-Wakīl), dont je me suis contenté pour repousser (le mal) et attirer (le bien), ô Seigneur de la création, ô Allah.
bayts.en: You are the Trustee (Al-Wakīl), with Whom I have been content in warding off (evil) and drawing (good), O Lord of creation, O Allah.
bayts.it: Tu sei il Garante (Al-Wakīl), del quale mi sono accontentato nel respingere (il male) e nell'attrarre (il bene), o Signore della creazione, o Allah.
